title: 池上
author: 白居易
intro: A little child sneaks out in a boat to pick white lotus — and gives the game away, because the boat leaves a clear path through the duckweed. A tiny comic scene told in twenty characters.
analysis: 这首诗像一个小故事。一个小孩撑着一条小船，偷偷去池塘里采白莲花，采完划回来。他以为没人知道，可是他不懂得藏起自己的踪迹：水面上漂满了浮萍，小船划过的地方，浮萍被分开，留下了一道清清楚楚的水路——这就把他“出卖”了。诗人用“偷采”和“不解”两个词，写出小孩的调皮和天真：做“坏事”很认真，却完全没想到会被发现。最后一句“浮萍一道开”是一个很有画面感的细节，读者仿佛站在岸边，看着那条绿色中间的水路笑了。整首诗语言浅白，像随手画的一幅小画，充满童趣，也能看出诗人看孩子时那种温和、喜爱的心情。
analysisEn: This poem tells a tiny story. A small child poles a little boat out onto the pond, picks some white lotus flowers on the sly, and rows back. The child thinks no one will know — but doesn’t know how to hide the evidence. The water is covered in floating duckweed, and wherever the boat passed, the duckweed has parted, leaving a clear open lane behind it. That trail gives the secret away. Two words carry the humour: 偷采 (“picking on the sly”) and 不解 (“didn’t know how to”). The child is very serious about the mischief and never imagines being found out. The last line, “a path opens through the duckweed”, is a sharp visual detail: you feel you are standing on the bank, looking at that lane through the green and smiling. The language is plain, like a quick sketch, full of a child’s fun — and you can feel the poet’s gentle fondness as he watches.
background: Bai Juyi (772–846) spent his last years in Luoyang, where his house had a garden with a pond. This is the second of two short poems titled “On the Pond”, traditionally dated to his old age there.
pronunciation: 撑 chēng；艇 tǐng（不读 tíng）；不解 jiě（懂得）。
version: 采用统编语文教材（一年级下册）文本，是《池上二绝》的第二首。各版本基本无异文。

lines.lit: A little child poles a little boat,
lines.en: A little child poles a little boat

lines.lit: secretly picks white lotus and comes back.
lines.en: out to steal white lotus, and back again,

lines.lit: Not knowing how to hide the traces,
lines.en: never thinking to cover the tracks —

lines.lit: the floating duckweed opens in one line.
lines.en: a clear lane splits the duckweed behind.

words.note: 现代汉语说“小孩儿”“娃娃”。

words.en: to push (a boat) with a pole
words.note: 现代汉语也用，如“撑船”“撑伞”。
“偷”= 偷偷地，这里只是调皮，不是真的偷东西。
“解”= 懂得；现代汉语说“不懂得”“不会”。
现代汉语也用，如“不见踪迹”。
漂在水面的小植物；也常比喻漂泊不定的人。

imagery.name: 莲
imagery.zh: 白莲是小孩“偷采”的目标，写出夏天池塘的清新和孩子的好奇。
imagery.en: White lotus is what the child sneaks out to pick — the freshness of a summer pond and a child’s curiosity.

imagery.name: 船
imagery.zh: 小船划过浮萍留下水路，成了孩子“露馅”的证据。
imagery.en: The little boat leaves a lane through the duckweed — the evidence that gives the child away.
